name: Wine Shop Advert
objectiveText: Go to the Gallina Winery, and bring Suzetta Gallina the Wine Ticket for a free bottle of wine. Wine Ticket (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
well if i knew how to post a screen shot ide show you kids on the map, but i dont
so if you dont have coordinates
go to the bridge between the trade distric ant the mage quarter
now go east on the bridge to the entrance to the trade district, and then go south down the path outside of the trade district
go to the very end, on your right will be water, turn left at the very end of the path and go in, she is inside there,
there, for once someone on here gave nice clear non coordinate directions!
This quest rewards 150 Stormwind reputation as of patch 2.01

When you are standing looking at the Guilded Rose go right and go through the tunnel, it's the first left hand turn, then take another left and it is right there, go in the door talk to the girl and finish the quest

Renato Gallina is a 57, 63 for those how don’t have coordinates that is when you come in the main entrance of Stormwind City he is to the left right in front of Pestle’s Apothecary he is standing on a crate.

You then have to run thought the trades district towards the bridge between the Mage Quarter and the Trade District *DON’T CROSS THE BRIDGE* turn left and head straight look for a sign that says Gallina Winery Go in there that’s were Suzetta Gallina 52, 67 is to complete this very easy quest. If you are trying to get Stormwind rep up its an easy 150 rep. for a 10 second run.

The target NPC [npc=1431] is at (52.5, 67.6) in Stormwind, and approachable starting from the bridge between Trade and Mage quarter (so it is behind and [b]not[/b] in the inn that is next to the bank).
its not at those coords. it's actually at 52, 67, in the trade quarter. But it is VERY easy.
not all of us have coordinates, please tell me how to get there, or tell me where i can find online, coordinates map

At level 8 (with the quest being grey, and 6 levels below mine), I got the full 75 Stormwind reputation for completing this quest. I do not remember getting full reputation for completing quests more than 5 levels below my level, so I assume either this is a change from the original game or full rep for low quests became a thing earlier than I remembered.

This is from the beta, so it may change in the future.

+75 Stormwind
+~19 Darnassus, Gnomeregan Exiles, and Ironforge
replies: How do you figure? Thats what I was looking for (reputation info). To the people that posted it, thanks.
